title: Board View cards use List's status pill and keep the design's text sizes
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-11-board-card-detailed-light-1440.png and DC-11-board-card-compact-light-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • The design pictures show the design's own tinted status badge; the product owner chose List's status pill for the cards, so compare the card's pill with List, not with the pictures.
  • The design cards also show the estimated hours and the created date, which are not default fields, and the Compact picture hides the hours, the progress bar and the money; the PRD says density never changes what is shown, so compare only the layout and the text sizes.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC11 Pia Card) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC11 Quinn Card) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC11 Board Card") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17831) for {Customer-A}, on an asset with a unit number (for example TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2), is led by {Technician-A} and has one approved line, {Line-1} (for example "Service - Full grease service"), whose technician is {Technician-B}.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17832) for {Customer-A} is Invoiced and led by {Technician-A}.
  • In Board View, Fields to display shows the default fields with Line technicians also turned on.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter (if the Asset on Site chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click List in the display switcher.
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Look at {Work-order-1}'s status pill and any red or blue number on it.
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  5. Look at {Work-order-1}'s card from top to bottom.
  6. Compare the size and weight of the number, the customer name, the unit and asset line and the total price with each other and with the design picture.
  7. Look at the status pill on {Work-order-1}'s card and compare it with the pill you saw in List at step 3.
  8. Look at {Work-order-2}'s card next to its number.
  9. Click the density button and choose Compact, and look at {Work-order-1}'s card.
  10. Click the density button and choose Comfortable, and look at {Work-order-1}'s card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the top line shows the number in blue at the left and the status pill at the right. Below it the customer name in dark text, then a smaller grey line with the unit and the asset separated by a dot (for example TRK-118 · 2022 Freightliner M2). Then a thin blue progress bar across the card, a thin divider, and the line technicians as overlapping round avatars at the left with the total price at the right. The card is white with rounded corners and a thin grey border, as in the Detailed design picture.
  • Step 6: the number, the customer name and the total price are the same size as each other (14 px in the design) and the same medium weight; none is bolder or larger than the others. The unit and asset line is clearly smaller (12 px in the design) and grey. Side by side with the design picture, the customer name is not bolder or larger than the number.
  • Step 7: the card's pill is the same pill as in List: the same colour, the same word, the same rounded shape, with the same red and blue numbers on it when List shows them, and it is 22 px tall, as tall as the badge on the cards in the Detailed design picture.
  • Step 8: a small padlock outline icon sits right after {Work-order-2}'s number.
  • Step 9: the card has less space around its content but shows the same fields and values, and every text keeps the same size as at step 6.
  • Step 10: the card has more space around its content, shows the same fields and values, and every text keeps the same size as at step 6.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View), SV-10048 (Story 5, Choose what is shown), SV-10049 (Story 6, Density), SV-10050 (Story 7, Line technicians); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R13, S5-R3, S3-R5, S6-R2, S6-R6 and S7-R1, read 15 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states core__work-orders__board-detailed__light__1440 and core__work-orders__board-compact__light__1440 (design pictures DC-11-board-card-detailed-light-1440.png, DC-11-board-card-compact-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Covers the design defects SV-11337 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Ahtasham Amjad). Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answers 22 and 27, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026, before the expected results changed on 15 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.

SV-11337 estimates the design's card text at about 15 px for the number, 15 to 16 px semibold for the customer, 13 px for the unit and asset line and 16 px semibold for the total; the ticket's estimated design sizes differ from the design file, which draws 14, 14, 12 and 14 px at medium weight on every card size; this case follows the design file. The design's Compact card hides the hours, the progress bar and the money; this case follows the PRD (density never changes what is shown). The design's card shows its own tinted badge without numbers; Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 22) that cards use List's production pill with the red and blue counts, 22 px tall, and (answer 27) that row and card text is 14 px at every density. PRD version 54 says so, and this case follows it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R13: “Board View’s default selection is lead technician name, work order number, customer, unit number, asset, progress, total price, and mandatory status, subject to financial permission.”
  • S5-R3: “Work order number, unit number when present, and status are mandatory and cannot be deselected.”
  • S3-R5: “Keep each card’s status badge in a fixed position.”
  • S3-R5a: “A Board View card’s status is the same status pill List shows in production, with the same red service-actions count and blue parts-actions count on it, as in Tech View (S2-R19), at the design’s card badge height (22px).”
  • S6-R2: “Density adjusts spacing and the size of rows, cards, and their elements.”
  • S6-R6: “Changing density never changes which fields, columns, or values are displayed.”
  • S7-R1: “Board View cards (when the line technicians field is on) and a new optional Assigned Techs column in Tech View show a compact avatar group: the lead technician plus the distinct technicians assigned to work order lines. List does not get this column.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View card number: “min-width: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: {{ wo.idColor }};”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View card customer: “font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: {{ wo.titleColor }};”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View card unit and asset line: “font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sv-text-secondary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">{{ wo.assetLine }}”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View card total price: “font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sv-text-primary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;">{{ wo.total }}”
  • S6-R4: “Row and card text is 14px at every density; Compact never shrinks it. Text the design sets at 12px at every density, such as column header labels (S2-R21), the progress percentage and secondary lines, stays 12px.”
